summary: Shows looping over inventory hosts with groups['all'] or ansible_play_batch, or the inventory_hostnames lookup with patterns like all:!www.
questions: How do I loop over all hosts in my inventory inside a task?
How do I loop over the hosts in the current play?
How do I loop over hosts matching a pattern?

answer_card.title: Looping over inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
loop: "{{ groups['all'] }}"           # all inventory hosts
loop: "{{ ansible_play_batch }}"      # hosts in the current play batch
loop: "{{ query('inventory_hostnames', 'all:!www') }}"   # pattern
```
